rules.radius: sqrt(30000 * intensity / 16): where retail's model light falls to 16
rules.color: record colour, times cap / 255 when cap is set, times its balance
rules.balance: each light scaled so the eight strongest default per-pixel contributions at its origin (radius x r_dlightScale 0.5, smoothstep(1 - d^2/R^2)) add at most 0.5
rules.selection: at most 128; round-robin over PVS clusters, strongest first by max(colour) * intensity
